Modification Discription: Causal attention in keras.layers.Attention and keras.layers.AdditiveAttention is now specified in the call() method via the use_causal_mask argument (rather than in the constructor), for consistency with other layers.
Function Description: Dot-product attention layer, a.k.a. Luong-style attention.

Modification Discription: Causal attention in keras.layers.Attention and keras.layers.AdditiveAttention is now specified in the call() method via the use_causal_mask argument (rather than in the constructor), for consistency with other layers.
Function Description: Additive attention layer, a.k.a. Bahdanau-style attention.

Modification Discription:
RNG behavior change for tf.keras.initializers. Keras initializers will now use stateless random ops to generate random numbers.
Both seeded and unseeded initializers will always generate the same values every time they are called (for a given variable shape). For unseeded initializers (seed=None), a random seed will be created and assigned at initializer creation (different initializer instances get different seeds).
An unseeded initializer will raise a warning if it is reused (called) multiple times. This is because it would produce the same values each time, which may not be intended.
Function Description: Keras initializer serialization / deserialization.

Modification Discription: Use tensorflow::OkStatus() instead of tensorflow::Status::OK().
tensorflow::StatusOr will also become in the future alias to absl::StatusOr, so use StatusOr::value instead of StatusOr::ConsumeValueOrDie
New argument experimental_device_ordinal in LogicalDeviceConfiguration to control the order of logical devices. (GPU only)
Function Description: Ordinal number to order the virtual device. LogicalDevice with lower ordinal number will receive a lower device id. Physical device id and location in the list is used to break ties. Currently only supported for Nvidia GPUs.

Modification Discription: Changed the TensorBoard tag names produced by the tf.keras.callbacks.TensorBoard callback, so that summaries logged automatically for model weights now include either a /histogram or /image suffix in their tag names, in order to prevent tag name collisions across summary types.
Function Description: Enable visualizations for TensorBoard.

Modification Discription: The tf.keras.optimizers.Optimizer base class now points to the new Keras optimizer, while the old optimizers have been moved to the tf.keras.optimizers.legacy namespace.
Function Description: Abstract optimizer base class.

Modification Discription: Learning rate schedule access. When using a tf.keras.optimizers.schedules.LearningRateSchedule, the new optimizer's learning_rate property returns the current learning rate value instead of a LearningRateSchedule object as before. If you need to access the LearningRateSchedule object, please use optimizer._learning_rate.
Function Description: The learning rate schedule base class.

Modification Discription: tf.lite: Updates to existing operations: tfl.mul now supports complex32 inputs.
Function Description:
Multiplication operator
Element-wise multiplication operation.

Modification Discription: TF Core: tf.custom_gradient can now be applied to functions that accept "composite" tensors, such as tf.RaggedTensor, as inputs.
Function Description: Decorator to define a function with a custom gradient.

Modification Discription: experimental_follow_type_hints for tf.function has been deprecated. Please use input_signature or reduce_retracing to minimize retracing.
Function Description: When True, the function may use type annotations from `func` to optimize the tracing performance. For example, arguments annotated with `tf.Tensor` will automatically be converted to a Tensor.

Modification Discription: Removed redundant packages tensorflow-gpu and tf-nightly-gpu. These packages were removed and replaced with packages that direct users to switch to tensorflow or tf-nightly respectively. Since TensorFlow 2.1, the only difference between these two sets of packages was their names, so there is no loss of functionality or GPU support. See https://pypi.org/project/tensorflow-gpu for more details.

Since TensorFlow 2.1, the only difference between these two sets of packages was their names, so there is no loss of functionality or GPU support. See https://pypi.org/project/tensorflow-gpu for more details.

tf.function now uses the Python inspect library directly for parsing the signature of the Python function it is decorated on. This change may break code where the function signature is malformed, but was ignored previously, such as:
Using functools.wraps on a function with different signature
Using functools.partial with an invalid tf.function input
tf.function now enforces input parameter names to be valid Python identifiers. Incompatible names are automatically sanitized similarly to existing SavedModel signature behavior.
Parameterless tf.functions are assumed to have an empty input_signature instead of an undefined one even if the input_signature is unspecified.
tf.types.experimental.TraceType now requires an additional placeholder_value method to be defined.
tf.function now traces with placeholder values generated by TraceType instead of the value itself.
Function Description: Compiles a function into a callable TensorFlow graph.

Modification Discription: tf.types.experimental.TraceType now requires an additional placeholder_value method to be defined.
Function Description: Represents the type of object(s) for tf.function tracing purposes.

Modification Discription: Experimental APIs tf.config.experimental.enable_mlir_graph_optimization and tf.config.experimental.disable_mlir_graph_optimization were removed.
Function Description: Enables experimental MLIR-Based TensorFlow Compiler Optimizations.

Modification Discription: Experimental APIs tf.config.experimental.enable_mlir_graph_optimization and tf.config.experimental.disable_mlir_graph_optimization were removed.
Function Description: Disables experimental MLIR-Based TensorFlow Compiler Optimizations.

Modification Discription: Coordination service now works with dtensor.initialize_accelerator_system, and enabled by default.
Function Description: Initializes accelerators and communication fabrics for DTensor.

Modification Discription: Top level stream_executor directory has been deleted, users should use equivalent headers and targets under compiler/xla/stream_executor.

tf.config.experimental.mlir_bridge_rollout
Removed enums MLIR_BRIDGE_ROLLOUT_SAFE_MODE_ENABLED and MLIR_BRIDGE_ROLLOUT_SAFE_MODE_FALLBACK_ENABLED which are no longer used by the tf2xla bridge

ConcreteFunction (tf.types.experimental.ConcreteFunction) as generated through get_concrete_function now performs holistic input validation similar to calling tf.function directly. This can cause breakages where existing calls pass Tensors with the wrong shape or omit certain non-Tensor arguments (including default values).
Function Description: Base class for differentiable graph functions.

Modification Discription: tf.nn: tf.nn.embedding_lookup_sparse and tf.nn.safe_embedding_lookup_sparse now support ids and weights described by tf.RaggedTensors.
Function Description: Looks up embeddings for the given ids and weights from a list of tensors.

Modification Discription: tf.nn: tf.nn.embedding_lookup_sparse and tf.nn.safe_embedding_lookup_sparse now support ids and weights described by tf.RaggedTensors.
Function Description: Lookup embedding results, accounting for invalid IDs and empty features.

Modification Discription: tf.data.Dataset.zip now supports Python-style zipping, i.e. Dataset.zip(a, b, c).
Function Description: Creates a Dataset by zipping together the given datasets.

Modification Discription: tf.data.Dataset.shuffle now supports tf.data.UNKNOWN_CARDINALITY When doing a "full shuffle" using dataset = dataset.shuffle(dataset.cardinality()). But remember, a "full shuffle" will load the full dataset into memory so that it can be shuffled, so make sure to only use this with small datasets or datasets of small objects (like filenames).
Function Description: Randomly shuffling input data

Modification Discription: tf.nn.top_k now supports specifying the output index type via parameter index_type. Supported types are tf.int16, tf.int32 (default), and tf.int64.
Function Description: Finds values and indices of the k largest entries for the last dimension.

Modification Discription: Changed resource variables to inherit from tf.compat.v2.Variable instead of tf.compat.v1.Variable. Some checks for isinstance(v, tf compat.v1.Variable) that previously returned True may now return False.

tf.experimental.dtensor: Deprecated dtensor.run_on in favor of dtensor.default_mesh to correctly indicate that the context does not override the mesh that the ops and functions will run on, it only sets a fallback default mesh.
tf.experimental.dtensor: List of members of dtensor.Layout and dtensor.Mesh have slightly changed as part of efforts to consolidate the C++ and Python source code with pybind11.
Function Description: Represents the layout information of a DTensor.

Modification Discription: tf.experimental.dtensor: List of members of dtensor.Layout and dtensor.Mesh have slightly changed as part of efforts to consolidate the C++ and Python source code with pybind11.
Function Description: Represents a Mesh configuration over a certain list of Mesh Dimensions.

Modification Discription: tf.experimental.dtensor: Most notably, dtensor.Layout.serialized_string is removed.
Function Description: Returns a serialized Protobuf binary string representation.

Modification Discription: tf.experimental.ExtensionType now supports Python tuple as the type annotation of its fields.
Function Description: Base class for TensorFlow ExtensionType classes.

Modification Discription: tf.nest: Deprecated API tf.nest.is_sequence has now been deleted. Please use tf.nest.is_nested instead.
Removed the Keras scikit-learn API wrappers (KerasClassifier and KerasRegressor), which had been deprecated in August 2021. We recommend using SciKeras instead.

Modification Discription: All the tf.keras.dtensor.experimental.optimizers classes have been merged with tf.keras.optimizers. You can migrate your code to use tf.keras.optimizers directly. The API namespace for tf.keras.dtensor.experimental.optimizers will be removed in future releases.
Function Description: Public API for tf.keras.dtensor.experimental.optimizers namespace.

Modification Discription: Remove the tf.keras.dtensor.experimental.layout_map_scope(). You can user the tf.keras.dtensor.experimental.LayoutMap.scope() instead.
Function Description: Apply the layout to all the tf.Variables created under the scope.

Modification Discription: The class hierarchy for tf.Tensor has changed, and there are now explicit EagerTensor and SymbolicTensor classes for eager and tf.function respectively. Users who relied on the exact type of Tensor (e.g. type(t) == tf.Tensor) will need to update their code to use isinstance(t, tf.Tensor). The tf.is_symbolic_tensor helper added in 2.13 may be used when it is necessary to determine if a value is specifically a symbolic tensor.
Function Description: represents a multidimensional array of elements.

Modification Discription: tf.compat.v1.Session: tf.compat.v1.Session.partial_run and tf.compat.v1.Session.partial_run_setup will be deprecated in the next release.
Function Description: Continues the execution with more feeds and fetches.

Modification Discription: tf.compat.v1.Session: tf.compat.v1.Session.partial_run and tf.compat.v1.Session.partial_run_setup will be deprecated in the next release.
Function Description: Sets up a graph with feeds and fetches for partial run.

Modification Discription:
tf.py_function and tf.numpy_function can now be used as function decorators for clearer code: @tf.py_function(Tout=tf.float32)
def my_fun(x):
  print("This always executes eagerly.")
  return x+1
Function Description: Wraps a python function into a TensorFlow op that executes it eagerly.

Modification Discription:
tf.py_function and tf.numpy_function can now be used as function decorators for clearer code: @tf.py_function(Tout=tf.float32)
def my_fun(x):

  return x+1
Function Description: Wraps a python function and uses it as a TensorFlow op.

Modification Discription:
API changes for Relayout. Added a new API, dtensor.relayout_like, for relayouting a tensor according to the layout of another tensor.
Added dtensor.get_default_mesh, for retrieving the current default mesh under the dtensor context.
*fft* ops now support dtensors with any layout. Fixed bug in 'fft2d/fft3d', 'ifft2d/ifft3d', 'rfft2d/rfft3d', and 'irfft2d/irfft3d' for sharde input. Refer to this blog post for details.
Function Description: Public API for tf._api.v2.experimental.dtensor namespace

Modification Discription: tf.ones, tf.zeros, tf.fill, tf.ones_like, tf.zeros_like now take an additional Layout argument that controls the output layout of their results.
Function Description: Creates a tensor with all elements set to one (1).

Modification Discription: tf.ones, tf.zeros, tf.fill, tf.ones_like, tf.zeros_like now take an additional Layout argument that controls the output layout of their results.
Function Description: Creates a tensor with all elements set to zero.

Function Description: Public API for tf._api.v2.data namespace

Modification Discription:
tf.keras: Model.compile now support steps_per_execution='auto' as a parameter, allowing automatic tuning of steps per execution during Model.fit,
Model.predict, and Model.evaluate for a significant performance boost.
Function Description: Configures the model for training.

Modification Discription: tf.types.experimental.GenericFunction has been renamed to tf.types.experimental.PolymorphicFunction.
Function Description: Base class for polymorphic graph functions.

Modification Discription: tf.types.experimental.TraceType now allows custom tf.function inputs to declare Tensor decomposition and type casting support.
Function Description: Represents the type of object(s) for tf.function tracing purposes.

Modification Discription: tf.data: Moved option warm_start from tf.data.experimental.OptimizationOptions to tf.data.Options.
Function Description: Whether to start background threads of asynchronous transformations upon iterator creation, as opposed to during the first call to next(). Defaults to False. This improves the latency of the initial 'next()' calls at the expense of requiring more memory to hold prefetched elements between the time of iterator construction and usage.

Modification Discription: tf.saved_model.SaveOptions: Provided a new experimental_skip_saver argument which, if specified, will suppress the addition of SavedModel-native save and restore ops to the SavedModel, for cases where users already build custom save/restore ops and checkpoint formats for the model being saved, and the creation of the SavedModel-native save/restore ops simply cause longer model serialization times.
Function Description: Options for saving to SavedModel.

Modification Discription: It now takes in a new argument called experimental_write_callbacks. These are callbacks that will be executed after a saving event finishes writing the checkpoint file.
It now takes a new argument called support_partition. If True, constant_initializers can create sharded variables. This is disabled by default, similar to existing behavior.
Function Description: Initializer that generates tensors with constant values.

Modification Discription: tf.summary.trace_on now takes a profiler_outdir argument. This must be set if profiler arg is set to True.
Function Description: Starts a trace to record computation graphs and profiling information.

Modification Discription: tf.summary.trace_export's profiler_outdir arg is now a no-op. Enabling the profiler now requires setting profiler_outdir in trace_on.
Function Description: Stops and exports the active trace as a Summary and/or profile file.

Modification Discription: The tf.estimator API is removed. To continue using tf.estimator, you will need to use TF 2.15 or an earlier version.
Function Description: a high-level API that encapsulates model training, evaluation, prediction, and exporting.

Modification Discription: These now take in a new argument called experimental_sharding_callback. This is a callback function wrapper that will be executed to determine how tensors will be split into shards when the saver writes the checkpoint shards to disk. tf.train.experimental.ShardByTaskPolicy is the default sharding behavior, but tf.train.experimental.MaxShardSizePolicy can be used to shard the checkpoint with a maximum shard file size. Users with advanced use cases can also write their own custom tf.train.experimental.ShardingCallbacks.
Function Description: Options for constructing a Checkpoint.

Modification Discription: These now take in a new argument called experimental_sharding_callback. This is a callback function wrapper that will be executed to determine how tensors will be split into shards when the saver writes the checkpoint shards to disk. tf.train.experimental.ShardByTaskPolicy is the default sharding behavior, but tf.train.experimental.MaxShardSizePolicy can be used to shard the checkpoint with a maximum shard file size. Users with advanced use cases can also write their own custom tf.train.experimental.ShardingCallbacks.
Function Description: Options for saving to SavedModel.

Modification Discription: SaveOptions now takes a new argument called experimental_debug_stripper. When enabled, this strips the debug nodes from both the node defs and the function defs of the graph. Note that this currently only strips the Assert nodes from the graph and converts them into NoOps instead.
Function Description: Options for saving to SavedModel.
